$description: The colour roles of the light theme. The pages use them as CSS custom properties of the same name.

bg-raised.$description: The sidebar, inputs and other parts above the page.

bg-panel.$description: The inside of a panel, and the tooltip of a chart.

bg-hover.$description: A row or a link under the pointer, and a neutral badge.

border.$description: Thin lines: panel edges, table rows and chart grid lines.

border-strong.$description: Strong lines: table heads, chart axes, and the edges of buttons, chips and drawers.

border-input.$description: The edge of a field: an input, a select or a text area.

text-dim.$description: Text that matters less: labels, and the text of chart axes.

text-faint.$description: Text that matters least, such as hints and time stamps.

accent.$description: Links, focus and the active item.

accent-dim.$description: A quiet accent fill: the active segment and the primary button.

on-accent.$description: Text on the accent fill: the active segment and the primary button.

chart.$description: The chart roles of the light theme. Charts draw on a canvas and take these from tokens.gen.ts.

series.$description: The colours of chart series, in order. Okabe-Ito, so that readers with colour blindness can tell them apart. Each is 3:1 or more on the light panel. The status colours are not among them.

1.$description: The first series: the accent of the theme.

2.$description: The second series: orange, darker than on dark.

5.$description: The fifth series: sky blue, darker than on dark.

7.$description: The seventh series: yellow, darker than on dark.

extra-series.$description: Two more series, for a chart that draws its first four in the accent and the status colours: the metrics chart. Each is 3:1 or more on the light panel.

1.$description: The fifth series of the metrics chart: violet, darker than on dark.

2.$description: The sixth series of the metrics chart: pink, darker than on dark.
